description: Retrieve the signed trust receipt for a checkout. A receipt records the complete_checkout call; read `order_placed` before telling anyone a purchase happened. Returns the receipt id, the JWS signature and how to verify it. Issuance is asynchronous: right after complete_checkout this may answer `status: "pending"` with a retry delay. `pending` with code `receipt_pending` means the purchase completed and the receipt is on its way; `checkout_in_progress` means it has not settled yet. Only the credential that made the purchase can read its receipt. Checkout guide: https://trusteed.xyz/.well-known/agent-checkout-guide.json.

agent_key.description: Sandbox credential from `create_sandbox_key`. Use this when your client cannot set an `Authorization: Bearer` header.

checkout_session_id.description: The checkout session id returned by create_cart and echoed by complete_checkout.

name: get_trust_receipt
